title: PBA: San Miguel escapes Ginebra rally in thriller to stay alive
summary: The San Miguel Beermen escaped Barangay Ginebra San Miguel in a Game 3 thriller, 101-98, to stay alive in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup Quarterfinals on Tuesday at the Dasmariñas Arena.
